purpose: Reconcile the frozen empty-mask POLICY document against the CANONICAL executable metric implementation, and prospectively fix which one Phase36 treats as authority for Dice/IoU on empty cases.

canonical_code.dice_definition: dice(c, eps=1e-7) = (2*tp + eps) / (2*tp + fp + fn + eps)
canonical_code.iou_definition: iou(c, eps=1e-7) = (tp + eps) / (tp + fp + fn + eps)

conflict.observed_difference: For a one-empty case (e.g. N foreground pixels on one side only) the policy document states Dice = 0.0 and IoU = 0.0 (absolutely), whereas the canonical executable metric returns eps/(N+eps) = 2.5e-10 (a positive value that is ABOVE 0.0 but far below any reporting precision). Both agree that BOTH-EMPTY = 1.0 and that HD95 = NaN.

authority_ruling.ruling: Phase36 v1.2 uses the canonical executable implementation (eps=1e-7) as the metric VALUE authority. The policy document is a rounded/idealised summary and is superseded for the exact numeric value only; its qualitative statements (both-empty = 1.0, one-empty ~ 0, HD95 empty = NaN+invalid) remain consistent with the code.
why_not_the_policy_document: The canonical executable metric is the same implementation used by Phase27/Phase29 clean-reference generation, so the clean-equivalence gate is only self-consistent if Phase36 evaluates Dice with the same function.
Substituting 0.0 for eps/(N+eps) would introduce a ~2.5e-10 systematic deviation that would break the isclose(atol=1e-7) clean-equivalence gate on legitimate empty-case samples.
The policy document already carries status FROZEN_POLICY for REPORTING semantics; it is not an executable spec.
authority_ruling.worst_case_effect_on_gate: NONE — difference (2.5e-10) is below the gate atol (1e-7) by 3 orders of magnitude.

phase36_v1_2_binding.hd95_empty_value: NaN with valid=False (never substituted, never zeroed)
phase36_v1_2_binding.implementation: phase36_robustness_execution_v1_2._dice/_iou/_hd95 delegate directly to the canonical module (no re-implementation).

historical_note: This reconciliation is PROSPECTIVE relative to any Phase36 science: it is recorded BEFORE the v1.2 smoke/science gates are opened. No observation of Phase36 perturbation results informed it.

prior_status.v1_1_behavior: v1.1 unit test 11/12 already asserted the canonical eps semantics but did not record the policy-document conflict; this reconciliation closes that gap.
prior_status.v1_0_behavior: v1.0 published EMPTY_MASK_POLICY = reports/audits/evaluation_empty_mask_policy.json without reconciling the one-empty numeric value.
